title: Igitabu casubiwemwo n'Ivyahishuriwe Yohana .
intro: Iyumvire ko wezwe umuntu ahambaye cane, hanyuma ugahangana n’itegeko riheza ubucuti kubera ukugamburuka. Ihishurirwa ryahinduye urugo rwose, kandi izina ryari hagati y’itegeko ntiryari ryigeze riba iryo ryari rivugwa.
clues: Nahagaze aho ukudahemuka kw’umuntu ku giti ciwe kwategerezwa kwemera ukugamburuka kw’Imana.
Namenyekanye mu rugo rw’Intumwa nk’umuhungu w’umuvyeyi.
Namenye ko ubugeni bwanje bwacitse ikintu c’ivyahishuriwe Intumwa ya Allah.
Numva amajambo ngo: ‘Gugama umugore wawe, utinye Allah,’ yerekejwe kuri jewe.
Naciye menya ko Allah yategetse Intumwa ya Allah gutana n’abagore bamwebamwe, kandi ubugeni bwanje ubwanje bwategerezwa guhera muri iryo tegeko.
Ndi Zayd ibn Harithah, umuhungu w’umuvyeyi yitwa muri Sura Al-Ahzb.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kubwirwa ngo agumye umugore wiwe hanyuma akamutegeka kumutana .
Kuryama mu mwobo mu binjana n'ibindi
trial.answer: Kubwirwa ngo agumye umugore wiwe hanyuma akamutegeka kumutana .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yarumviye itegeko, arahana n’umugore wiwe, ubugeni burasenyuka .
Yarokowe mw'itanure ry'umuriro ata co akomerewe
Yarahawe ububasha bwo kuganza mu Buseruko no mu Burengero .
outcome.answer: Yarumviye itegeko, arahana n’umugore wiwe, ubugeni burasenyuka .

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
